title: The Blood River Tianzun
summary: Xiao Yan saves Xiao Xiao, who can walk on air, and finds Medusa still defending the Mystic Yellow Fortress. He defeats Shi Tian, the 6-star Dou Zun leader of the Profound Lion Sect. The Ninth Tianzun of the Hall of Souls then comes for him, but his Dragon-Phoenix power and Great Heavenly Creation Palm overwhelm her, and he grabs her by the hand. She calls on the Fourth Tianzun, the Blood River Elder, who kills the Ninth Tianzun instead. The Fourth Tianzun is at the peak of 9-star Dou Zun, and her Blood Transformation Art drains blood even from her own side. Xiao Yan shows his Xiao Clan mark, blocks her Blood Fiend Heavenly Demon Palm with the Five Ring Flame Expelling Formation, and wounds her with the Extermination Fire Lotus. She flees with the Blood Escape Art, and Xiao Yan accepts the Profound Lion Sect men who sincerely surrender.
events: Xiao Yan rescues Xiao Xiao and reunites with Medusa.
The Ninth Tianzun attacks and is overpowered.
The Fourth Tianzun (Blood River Elder) arrives and kills the Ninth Tianzun.
Her Blood Transformation Art drains her own allies.
Xiao Yan uses the clan mark and the Five Ring Flame Expelling Formation.
His Extermination Fire Lotus wounds her; she flees by Blood Escape Art.
The Profound Lion Sect's remnants surrender.
cultivation: Shi Tian is a 6-star Dou Zun. The Ninth Tianzun says Xiao Yan 'has reached the peak of Eight-Star'. The Fourth Tianzun is at peak 9-star Dou Zun and near Dou Sheng ('Nine turns to become a Dou Sheng').
